FII and DII FII और DII

Foreign Institutional Investors and Domestic Institutional Investors. Their buying and selling is watched as a market signal.

विदेशी संस्थागत निवेशक और घरेलू संस्थागत निवेशक। इनकी ख़रीद-बिक्री को बाज़ार का संकेत माना जाता है।

How it is used in the lessons

Foreign institutional investors (FII) and domestic institutional investors (DII): mutual funds, insurers and others.
